record.field: # MO - Link/Unlink Toggle: For MANUALLY created MOs only # Auto-created MOs (from SO confirmation) are linked via stock_reference_ids - cannot be unlinked # This action only works with MOs where you manually set the Source/Origin field # Check if MRP module is installed try: mrp_production = env['mrp.production'] except KeyError: raise UserError("Manufacturing (MRP) module is not installed. Please install it first.") # Get MOs that are auto-created (linked via stock_reference_ids) auto_linked_mo_ids = set() if hasattr(record, 'stock_reference_ids') and record.stock_reference_ids: auto_mos = record.stock_reference_ids.production_ids.filtered( lambda mo: mo.state != 'cancel' ) auto_linked_mo_ids = set(auto_mos.ids) # Find MOs where origin (Source field) matches this SO's name origin_mos = mrp_production.search([ ('origin', '=', record.name), ('state', '!=', 'cancel') ]) # Separate manually linked MOs (origin matches but NOT in auto-linked) manually_linked_mos = origin_mos.filtered(lambda mo: mo.id not in auto_linked_mo_ids) # MOs that are ONLY auto-linked (no manual origin set, or origin cleared) auto_only_mos = mrp_production.browse(list(auto_linked_mo_ids - set(origin_mos.ids))) if manually_linked_mos: # === UNLINK MODE: Clear origin for manually linked MOs === mo_names = [] for mo in manually_linked_mos: mo_names.append(mo.name) mo.write({'origin': False}) # Add chatter message in MO so_link = f"{record.name}" mo.message_post(body=f"Unlinked from Sales Order {so_link}") # Invalidate cache to refresh computed field record.invalidate_recordset(['mrp_production_ids', 'mrp_production_count']) # Log in Sales Order mo_links = ', '.join([f"{mo.name}" for mo in manually_linked_mos]) record.message_post(body=f"Unlinked {len(manually_linked_mos)} manually linked MO(s): {mo_links}") action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'MOs Unlinked', 'message': f"Successfully unlinked {len(manually_linked_mos)} manually linked MO(s):\n" + "\n".join(mo_names), 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, 'next': {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'soft_reload'}, } } elif auto_linked_mo_ids: # Only auto-linked MOs exist - cannot unlink these auto_mo_names = ', '.join([mo.name for mo in mrp_production.browse(list(auto_linked_mo_ids))]) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'Cannot Unlink Auto-Created MOs', 'message': f"The following MO(s) were auto-created when confirming this SO and cannot be unlinked:\n{auto_mo_names}\n\nThis action only works with manually linked MOs.", 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } else: # === LINK MODE: No MOs linked, show instructions === action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'No MOs to Link/Unlink', 'message': f"No Manufacturing Orders found with Source = '{record.name}'.\n\nTo link MOs:\n1. Open the Manufacturing Order\n2. Go to Miscellaneous tab\n3. Set Source field to '{record.name}'\n4. Click this action again to confirm the link", 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } }

# Link/Unlink MO to Sales Order # If origin is set and matches an SO -> Unlink (clear origin) # If origin is empty -> Show wizard to select SO to link for mo in records: if mo.origin: # Check if origin matches a Sales Order sale_order = env['sale.order'].search([('name', '=', mo.origin)], limit=1) if sale_order: # Currently linked - unlink it old_origin = mo.origin mo.write({'origin': False}) # Post messages so_link = f"{old_origin}" mo.message_post(body=f"Unlinked from Sales Order {so_link}") mo_link = f"{mo.name}" sale_order.message_post(body=f"Unlinked Manufacturing Order {mo_link}") # Invalidate SO cache sale_order.invalidate_recordset(['mrp_production_ids', 'mrp_production_count']) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'Unlinked from SO', 'message': f"MO {mo.name} unlinked from {old_origin}", 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, 'next': {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'soft_reload'}, } } else: # Origin doesn't match any SO - just inform action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'Source Already Set', 'message': f"Source field is set to '{mo.origin}' but no matching Sales Order found.\n\nTo link to a different SO, first clear the Source field manually.", 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } else: # No origin - open wizard to select SO action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': 'Link to Sales Order', 'res_model': 'vpa.mo.link.wizard', 'view_mode': 'form', 'target': 'new', 'context': {'default_production_id': mo.id}, }
